: Project notebooks {#tbl-notebook-overview}

| Dataset | What is the data about | Reason for inclusion |
|---|---|---|
| Holidays [@workingdays_holidays] | City, state, bank, and corporate holidays, including the day of the week | Different holiday types affect different rider groups, and trip behavior varies by weekday/weekend |
| Weather[^weather-note] [@open_meteo_weather] | Hourly temperature, rain, snowfall, and wind speed for Chicago | Captures day/night and seasonal weather effects on demand at an hourly resolution matching the trip data |
| Points of Interest [@openstreetmap] | Counts of 8 POI categories (healthcare, education, public services, tourism, nature, amenity, leisure, shops) per census tract and community area | Explains the purpose/attractiveness of a location, helping the model learn location-specific demand patterns |
| Community area / census tract boundaries [@chicago_community_areas] | Polygon boundaries of Chicago's community areas | Used to compute community area centroid coordinates as a spatial feature |

: Additional data sources {#tbl-additional-data-sources}

[^weather-note]: We decided for a different weather data source to have hourly data.

## SVR {#sec-app-svr-features}

@tbl-svr-features lists the input features used by the SVR models. Cyclic temporal features and the point-of-interest counts are used at every temporal resolution except the daily bin, where `hour_sin` / `hour_cos` are dropped since an hour-of-day signal is meaningless when every basket spans a full day. The target-encoding feature `spatial_target_mean` is only included in configurations where target encoding is enabled, which includes the final selected SVR (community areas, 4h resolution).

| Category | Feature(s) | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Temporal (cyclic) | `hour_sin`, `hour_cos`, `month_sin`, `month_cos` | Sine/cosine encoding of hour-of-day and month-of-year, avoiding a false linear ordering of cyclic time |
| Day of week | `DayOfWeek_Tuesday`, `DayOfWeek_Wednesday`, `DayOfWeek_Thursday`, `DayOfWeek_Friday`, `DayOfWeek_Saturday`, `DayOfWeek_Sunday` | One-hot encoded weekday (Monday is the reference category) |
| Holidays | `BankHoliday`, `CorporateHoliday`, `CityHoliday`, `StateHoliday` | Binary flags for different holiday types, which affect rider groups differently |
| Weather (binary) | `rain`, `strong_rain`, `snow`, `wind`, `strong_wind` | Discretized weather conditions for the bucket |
| Weather (continuous) | `temperature_c`, `temperature_max_c`, `temperature_min_c` | Mean, max, and min temperature for the bucket |
| Points of interest | `healthcare`, `education`, `amenity`, `leisure`, `shops`, `public_services`, `tourism`, `nature` | Counts of each POI category within the spatial unit |
| Spatial | `centroid_lat`, `centroid_lon` | Centroid coordinates of the spatial unit, letting the model learn geographic proximity |
| Target encoding | `spatial_target_mean` | Mean trip count per spatial unit, computed on the training set only (included only when target encoding is enabled) |
